findings.title: Legacy challenge scoring sends expected answers to the solver
findings.statement: cmd_challenge_score serializes the complete case, including expected/answer, as a solver argument. A fake solver that merely echoes that value receives CORRECT. This defeats the intended hidden-case separation before checker quality matters.
findings.next_action: Pass only explicitly public inputs; keep expected values solely in the host oracle and test adversarial echoing.
findings.limitations: Synthetic cases only; no actual hidden case, private key, executable deliverable or subprocess was accessed/executed.

findings.title: Challenge judge and freeze hashes are not recomputed at scoring
findings.statement: The scorer checks shared challenge IDs, equality of copied commitment strings and deliverable bytes, but never recomputes the judge commitment or freeze_record_hash. Mutating the synthetic expected answer while leaving both commitments unchanged still scores successfully.
findings.next_action: Recompute canonical commitments over the exact judge/task/limits and freeze payload; bind checker identity/source and reject any mismatch before dispatch.
findings.limitations: This is the legacy CLI scorer, not a claim about the separate accounted challenge adapter. Arbitrary hash strings were synthetic.

findings.title: The advertised dual checkers are one equality predicate duplicated
findings.statement: Both chk_a and chk_b evaluate expected == actual. They share all mistakes and cannot disagree except for a synthetic fault branch; Python also treats True equal to1. The control returns CORRECT for expected1 and answertrue.
findings.next_action: Use independent admitted predicates or accurately label one check; require exact JSON types before equality and bind the actual candidate field.
findings.limitations: Does not prove every task needs two implementations; it disproves the current independence claim and strict integer discrimination.

findings.title: Empty swarm verification emits Verified
findings.statement: The contract loader requires only the version. Empty verifier_routes return all_passed=True; absent targets produce no blocking audit, and cmd_run_swarm emits PASS_TO_MASTER/Verified. The complete orchestration control reproduced that outcome with fake I/O.
findings.next_action: Require nonempty bound verifier coverage and candidate targets, or classify the empty result as NOT_RUN/UNVERIFIED; bind each result to exact contract/candidate bytes.
findings.limitations: Governance precondition and all file/output operations were faked in the control; no original contract, command or corpus was modified.

findings.title: Task operations and budgets are declarations without execution isolation
findings.statement: Generic task allowed_operations/stopping_bounds are appended to objective prose. Swarm verifier commands run as subprocesses under repository cwd; allowed paths and budget fields are not an OS/tool/network/money boundary in this caller. A governance digest does not supply missing enforcement.
findings.next_action: Define which layer enforces each constraint and reject unsupported enforcement requests; report prompt-only limits as declarations and run untrusted commands only through an enforcing port.
findings.limitations: Static caller review; no command escape or network action was attempted. External launch/sandbox policy could add restrictions, but is not established by these functions.

findings.title: StageB can erase uncertain charges or accept invalid cost arithmetic
findings.statement: One reservation covers dispatch retries, which retain only the last response. Timeout/URL/OSError settles zero and releases the hold; usage fields are int-coerced, accepting negative/Boolean values and empty usage as zero. Budget.settle permits spend above its cap. Four isolated controls reproduce timeout release, negative/empty usage and over-cap settlement.
findings.next_action: Reserve and record each attempt; retain holds on unknown liability; validate exact nonnegative usage and billed amounts; stop with an accounting failure when actual liability exceeds the admitted cap.
findings.limitations: The stored1600-call sample has coherent nonnegative declared charges; this finding concerns failure behavior of the source runner if its lock/preflight admits a run. No paid call occurred.

findings.title: StageB raw custody is written after scoring and all parallel jobs
findings.statement: _one_call invokes score before creating the raw receipt, and run materializes every future before writing either JSONL file. An exception in scoring or one worker can prevent preservation of already completed, potentially billed responses. The known local detector NameError is one concrete scoring failure.
findings.next_action: Persist request/attempt/raw response before scoring, use per-attempt durable settlement/failure receipts, and collate worker failures without discarding completed evidence.
findings.limitations: Source-confirmed failure path, not a new provider experiment or proof that the historical saved run lost bytes. Canonical two-attempt ports have different behavior.

findings.title: Missing ladder observations become favorable empirical evidence
findings.statement: evaluate_hypotheses substitutes default accuracy, cost, heldout gain, bluff rates and zero error counts when evidence_data is absent or partial. These literals are passed into H1-H13 evaluation as if observed. Repeating the same P0 gate is replay agreement, not independent checking.
findings.next_action: Require complete provenance-bearing observations per hypothesis and return NOT_RUN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when absent; put synthetic examples behind an explicit fixture-only mode.
findings.limitations: No domain hypothesis implementation or model was rerun. The defect is the caller manufacturing measurement inputs, regardless of each downstream acceptance threshold.

findings.title: Local detector crashes on the obstruction branch
findings.statement: run_local defines vertices, edges, omega and owner, then iterates undefined core when the delegated verdict is an obstruction. The synthetic obstruction control raises NameError instead of returning a red witness or refusal.
findings.next_action: Use the intended bound cochain and add red-branch witness/ownership controls; retain scoring failures without losing raw call custody.
findings.limitations: Fake finite validator only; no imported native or detector package executed.

findings.title: Machine-block parsing admits scalars and arrays that the evaluator cannot handle
findings.statement: ParseMachineBlockUseCase returns arbitrary json.loads output. EvaluateLlmTurnUseCase catches parsing exceptions, but required-field membership and parsed.get run afterward; a valid JSON number/list/null can raise instead of producing a typed refusal. Duplicate keys also collapse before policy checking.
findings.next_action: Require a closed object with duplicate-key/nonfinite rejection inside the parser and keep all schema/type failures within the refusal path.
findings.limitations: Source control-flow finding; canonical pfp_proposal uses stricter JSON and is a separate route. No production full lifecycle replay was performed.

findings.title: An opaque dual reference is treated as enough for exact reply structure
findings.statement: The legacy turn evaluator only checks dual_witness_ref truthiness when residual_colour is Exact. Its inherited-meaning detector checks two prose phrases. Those checks cannot establish witness feasibility, candidate/problem binding or semantic validity; ACCEPTED must remain structural only.
findings.next_action: Resolve and verify a witness against the exact candidate/problem before any mathematical exactness claim, or expose an explicit STRUCTURALLY_VALID_UNVERIFIED outcome.
findings.limitations: No claim that a canonical native certificate checker accepts this reference; this is the legacy application policy boundary.

findings.title: Prompt-to-turn helper drops declared kill conditions
findings.statement: build_payload_from_prompt_artifact carries required_reply_fields and body identity but does not pass artifact.kill_conditions into LlmTurnPayloadV1.create. Downstream policy can therefore differ from the compiled artifact despite the shared artifact ID.
findings.next_action: Carry the exact kill-condition set and other admitted policy fields, then validate prompt/turn policy correspondence; add a nonempty-condition regression.
findings.limitations: The separately owned canonical domain helper/CLI may use a stronger path. This finding applies to this exported application helper, not every prompt compilation route.

findings.title: Stage7 replay return is bound to labels rather than witness bodies
findings.statement: The caller validates replay type/demo/stage/count/candidate_id/expected_accept but does not compare a digest of each submitted witness or problem. Reusing matching labels can conceal a stale result unless the injected verifier enforces full binding itself.
findings.next_action: Include exact challenge/witness/problem digests in ChallengeReplay and compare them here; require independent checking of the bound bytes.
findings.limitations: Contract gap at the caller boundary, not a reproduced failure of the concrete host verifier. Prior domain PFPDOMAIN-F042 concerns a different stage/body binding gap.

findings.title: Pilot-suite objective digest omits grading and resource inputs
findings.statement: The objective hash includes pilot/model/checker label and messages, but omits the expected answer, source hashes and call/token/cost limits used by the run. Different grading/resource contracts can therefore share the same objective identity.
findings.next_action: Hash a versioned complete plan including public input, hidden/reference commitment, checker source/configuration and resource policy; keep secret values out of model-visible fields.
findings.limitations: Run ID and stored summaries provide additional identity; no claim that they are overwritten or that concrete accounting adapters ignore their own plan. This is an incomplete objective commitment.

findings.title: Corpus freezing hashes ambiguous IDs rather than content
findings.statement: Joining sorted IDs with commas collides for ["a,b","c"] and ["a","b,c"]. No sample content is bound. The isolated helper control produces identical digests for these different synthetic sample sets.
findings.next_action: Use length-delimited/canonical structured IDs plus per-sample content digests, and bind empirical counts to exact sample membership/receipts.
findings.limitations: Control replaces the domain return object; unrestricted IDs reach this helper before any downstream domain constraint. If a caller independently forbids commas the demonstrated collision is excluded, but sample content is still unbound.

findings.title: Coboundary score schema permits undefined rationals and inconsistent flags
findings.statement: The rational regex admits 1/0 and00/00, and the schema accepts is_exact_candidate=true with is_legal=false when its other syntactic conditions are met. The schema-only control validates such a record.
findings.next_action: Enforce denominator>0 and canonical exact values in a runtime decoder, cross-check exact/legal/objective relations, and keep schema-valid separate from verified score.
findings.limitations: No native decoder or primal-dual verifier was bypassed. A JSON Schema acceptance is not itself a mathematical certificate.

findings.title: Finite CSP normalization silently changes the supplied mathematical state
findings.statement: normalize_state applies str to variable names and int to values before checking duplicates. The control maps x=1.9,y=true to integer x=1,y=1, so malformed/noninteger inputs are solved as a different state.
findings.next_action: Reject values unless type(value) is int and require an explicit variable-name grammar; treat any intended coercion as a separately declared encoding.
findings.limitations: Bounded fixture owner only; no claim about canonical exact native CSP admission.

findings.title: MUB6 builder contradicts its own zero-float declaration
findings.statement: The constraints advertise exact rational arithmetic with zero float leakage, but default cochain construction converts12133/30000 to float before assigning six edges. Custom carriers also coexist with a fixed six-cycle wire.
findings.next_action: Retain Fraction/exact scalar values through construction and bind the actual carrier/wire; otherwise explicitly label this a floating diagnostic and refuse exactness claims.
findings.limitations: Payload already requests Rust functional replay and explicitly disclaims a global MUB6 theorem. No exact native verifier result is being refuted.

findings.title: Historical custody is not a unique current path-to-byte commitment
findings.statement: The source manifest lists three paths twice with different hashes. Current StageA-summary/execution-manifest/QDDC artifact pins also mismatch, including after LF/CRLF projection. The local historical base commit is unavailable, so these are unresolved edition/relocation bindings rather than demonstrated source loss. The large migration map intentionally keeps multiple historical map hashes and a self-map null pin.
findings.next_action: Preserve all historical bytes; recover exact source snapshot/namespace maps and issue a separate reconciliation receipt rather than rewriting old pins. Distinguish same-edition duplicate paths from explicit previous-edition map references.
findings.limitations: No original archive/Git reconstruction was possible in this slice, and no network fetch occurred. Literal comparison to8050 inventory metadata is not a loss verdict.

findings.title: StageB AUC analysis is not independent predictive validation
findings.statement: Primary AUC fits and evaluates on the same sample. The auxiliary out-of-fold computation receives design matrices standardized using all rows, leaking test-fold feature statistics. Neither number proves independent prospective detector adequacy.
findings.next_action: Fit preprocessing inside each training fold; report in-sample and prospective/cross-validated estimates separately with preregistered uncertainty and an adequate failure sample.
findings.limitations: The stored decision is already DROPPED and this review does not overturn it. No bootstrap or model experiment rerun.

findings.title: Legacy coboundary exactness counts claimed IDs without verifying membership or the dual
findings.statement: The legacy EvaluateCoboundaryScoreUseCase deduplicates/caps claimed obstruction count but receives only a total, not the actual open-ID set. Saturating that count plus a non-None dual reference marks is_exact_candidate without witness replay.
findings.next_action: Require the bound open-obstruction set, validate each claimed elimination and exact dual certificate, or rename the result as a declared cardinality diagnostic.
findings.limitations: Canonical score_discrete/cochain delegate to a separate exact Rust path. This finding does not claim their primal-dual validation is absent.

file_reviews.assessment: Full witness replay read. Different arithmetic path uses Cramer and separately loaded dossier mv/check_answer; nonempty witnesses require every named step defective. Outcome judge uses first answer step and original posed system, with all-coordinate check delegated.
file_reviews.limitations: Witness coefficients are ignored: this checks defect support, not dual feasibility/value. Duplicate step IDs collapse and missing citation/shape errors may escape; Stage B adds stricter single-answer guard. Independence is implementation diversity with shared generator/runtime, not mathematical or statistical independence.

file_reviews.assessment: Full documentation-integrity service read. Forwards request plus injected clock time to gateway without changing result.
file_reviews.limitations: Gateway custody and command safety are delegated, not proved by this service.

file_reviews.assessment: Full certified-ladder use case including 13 public P0 controls read. Repeats the same gate twice and compares status; expected scalar is fixed at 3 even for a custom item bank. P0 pass requires rejected negatives and matching positive expectations, not every negative expected refusal reason. evaluate_hypotheses substitutes favorable accuracy/cost/gain/zero-failure defaults when empirical fields are absent.
file_reviews.limitations: Two identical passes are replay agreement, not independent judges. Default metric values are synthetic assumptions and cannot support empirical hypotheses. Host gates and hypothesis predicates belong to domain review.

file_reviews.assessment: Full adversary-gate use case read. Injected tribunal result is returned; pilot conversion carries target/status/checker/prompt or caller receipt. gate_id argument is unused and an existing mismatching demo_id is retained.
file_reviews.limitations: No caller-level receipt-binding or gate-selection enforcement. Actual adapter may validate; no fresh evaluation performed.

file_reviews.assessment: Full pilot evaluator read. Revalidates typed response binding, audits prompt, parses actual raw reply and invokes fixed host checker against pilot expected_answer. Missing candidate yields NOT_RUN, malformed reply fails, accepted result transitions pilot state. Injected storage/gate_evaluator/runner are unused by this path.
file_reviews.limitations: Acceptance depends on host reference and checker adequacy, not a derivation from prompt; older observation/receipt fallback remains separate from typed raw-byte branch.

file_reviews.assessment: Full pilot-suite orchestration read. Validates finite case/call/token/cost caps, explicit model/provider preflight, new output directory and noncolliding portable response names. Dry-run uses host answer and labels self-consistency distinctly. Unknown costs stay nullable; ratios require completed unique plain/template pairs. Objective hash binds model/checker/messages but not expected answer, raw source bytes or resource bounds; grading uses one seed answer for all supplied specs.
file_reviews.limitations: No execution/provider calls. Port owns durable reservation and dispatch; post-preflight dispatch/grade/write exceptions escape the Result boundary. Correctness ratios are conditional on eligible replies and accompanied by malformed counts; not total-task accuracy or causal evidence.

file_reviews.assessment: Full numbered-stage execution adapter read. Catalog and exact typed host Stage5 response required; model JSON rejects duplicate/nonfinite tokens, strict integer schemas and cross-stage candidate references. Pilot answer acceptance remains NOT_RUN after pipeline completion. Replay return matches demo/stage/count/candidate labels/expected flags, but caller does not compare witness bytes; actual witness checking depends on verifier. Provider is called directly without this layer reserving money/tool budgets.
file_reviews.limitations: Mode receipts and host verdict are injected trust boundaries. Schema validation occurs after dispatch; external schema retrieval is not locally disabled in this adapter. Candidate semantics and ledger persistence are not supplied by AuthorityEffect=None.

file_reviews.assessment: Full finite Z2 gauge workbench read. Enumerates bit assignments within node budget, directly checks each edge XOR, compares validity with injected checker, then compares exact indexed checked sequence against search-and-replay receipt. Floating satisfied-edge fraction is UI-only; terminal comes from replay port. Run/input/checker hashes and explicit finite-grammar scope are useful.
file_reviews.limitations: Not a physical/QM derivation; replay port is trusted for receipt semantics and identity. Shallow snapshot/event copies expose nested mutable objects to caller/sink; concurrency is not a sandbox.

file_reviews.assessment: Full learning use cases read. FreezeCorpus hashes sorted unique sample IDs joined by commas, not sample content; delimiter framing is ambiguous for unrestricted IDs. Policy score is arithmetic over caller-supplied success counts and mean residual drops, with no link to corpus membership/count or trial receipts.
file_reviews.limitations: No policy learning or empirical evaluation executed. Domain constructors may reject numeric/ID shapes, but cannot derive missing evidence.

file_reviews.assessment: Full LLM-turn lifecycle read. Content hashes, accepted attempt linkage, packet membership and body digest checks defend substitutions; candidate count advances on distinct submissions. Parser accepts any json.loads result and duplicate keys; later required-field membership/get assumes a mapping. Exact residual requires only a truthy dual_witness_ref, not witness resolution or checking. Inherited-meaning detector is two case-sensitive substrings. ACCEPTED is this structural detector result, not truth/proof.
file_reviews.limitations: Domain checks delegated; no provider calls. Need bounded malformed-object controls. Operation cost is one per submission, not token/money/tool accounting.

file_reviews.assessment: Full mode discovery/validation use cases read. Lists or retrieves injected contract catalog and delegates catalog validation.
file_reviews.limitations: Mode declaration/structural closure is not executable semantics, evidence of a successful check, or mathematical proof.

file_reviews.assessment: Full MSSN control evaluator read. Requires nonempty unique case IDs, copies payload for checker and distinguishes observed PASS/REFUSED from expected pair; optional mismatch raises typed refusal.
file_reviews.limitations: No checker independence/adequacy guarantee; expected outcomes are supplied fixture assertions. assert_expectations_match alone accepts an empty outcome list.

file_reviews.assessment: Full calculation/workpad schema construction read. Exact field-carrier key matching, copied result schemas, closed objects, text bounds and at most three public records; optional prompt identity const.
file_reviews.limitations: Schema establishes shape and labels only; expression strings are not evaluated, result is not proved equal to expression, and no-prompt-id variant is not bound to a specific task.

file_reviews.assessment: Full seven executable-mode adapters read. Bounded grammar roundtrip, prompt keyword controls, resource-hashed typed skill trees, all permutations up to five vertices, finite involution cancellation and FD chase up to six attributes. Exact case/field validation and explicit scope limits distinguish syntax from semantic claims. Mode19 checks a supplied two-mark model rather than deriving ontology.
file_reviews.limitations: Host-supplied controls are not detector adequacy. Skill dependencies are checked for presence, not execution order; typing and instruction concatenation grant no capability. Mathematical correctness of delegated topology/involution/chase predicates belongs to domain reports.

file_reviews.assessment: Full proposal-checking owner read. Strict common envelope, native Boolean normalization, deep copies per judge and disagreement/exception distinctions prevent obvious self-grading. Repair text comes from bounded host dictionary. Task-turn schema regenerated from task and attempt constant, binding schema/input identities before judging. Schema reference graph prohibits external refs and same-instance cycles, integer type is exact Python int.
file_reviews.limitations: Judges are injected; agreement does not establish independence/adequacy. Task answer is TASK_CHECKED even on rejection, whereas no checker leaves UNVERIFIED. No provider calls or new mathematical solution.

file_reviews.assessment: Full two-attempt policy and numbered pipeline controller read. Max two stages enforced exactly; only whitelisted feedback allows repair. Reservation and request precede dispatch; transport/accounting failures retain holds and stop. Host stage separation, dependencies, acceptance-stage coverage and recomputed receipt terminal constrain positive completion.
file_reviews.limitations: Port owns accounting durability and real limits; exceptions in record_request/record_raw/observe lie outside guarded failure handling. Finite retry bound is not convergence or provider-effectiveness evidence; all_stages_passed may coexist with VERIFIED_WITH_RESIDUALS.

file_reviews.assessment: Full problem-builder lazy export wiring read. Dispatches Airy/Coda/MUB6 factories and constants without eager loading.
file_reviews.limitations: No mathematical checker or source-custody enforcement itself.

file_reviews.assessment: Full Airy five-slot builder read. Checks source/parent digest shapes, builds lambda*(z^2-1) carrier and exact/zero synthetic detector controls with projector-derived digests; binds initial state and payload to packet with fixed step budget.
file_reviews.limitations: Two controls do not establish global detector adequacy. Hash shape is not source availability. Complex float representation is numerical; lambda=0 needs lower-layer exclusion or zero-state control expectation ceases to hold.

file_reviews.assessment: Full Coda builder read. Finite carrier/support checks, initial-state/source hashing, distinct Phi1/Gamma2 protected IDs and same-carrier transform declaration. Controls include zero and the input projection itself.
file_reviews.limitations: Initial expected active IDs are computed by the same projector under test; not independent adequacy evidence. Named exact carrier uses float-valued construction here; optional parent produces witness text parent:None.

file_reviews.assessment: Full MUB6 builder read. Exact rational constants and explicit no-global-MUB-bound firewall; canonical six-cycle wire and initial-state/custody bindings. Payload explicitly requires Rust functional replay.
file_reviews.limitations: Contrary to zero-float constraint string, default margin is converted to binary float before cochain construction. Custom carrier support may pass while fixed six-cycle wire/labels remain unchanged. Circulation reference is not by itself Phi1 or a MUB6 theorem; projector-generated controls are not independent.

file_reviews.assessment: Full problem runner read. run_problem immediately requires unavailable Rust functional boundary; specimen text claims are merely supplied labels routed into that guard.
file_reviews.limitations: No actual multiround reduction, convergence, homology or debate effectiveness is established by this stub.

file_reviews.assessment: Full prompt-artifact application read. Canonical domain compilation and separate body/JSON identities; exclusive-create content-addressed writes compare collisions. Elimination block parser rejects duplicate named fields. build_payload_from_prompt_artifact carries required_reply_fields but omits artifact.kill_conditions, so downstream turn policy can differ. CompilePromptUseCase silently maps unknown regime to prose, ignores regime_metadata, and uses a synthesized regime descriptor. Residual validation only checks object key presence.
file_reviews.limitations: Receipt construction records host assertions; it does not execute elimination checks. Writes not executed; no durability or symlink confinement claim.

file_reviews.assessment: Full research intake/checking use cases read. Canonical envelope parser enforces family/carrier/boundaries/state/manifest/policy consistency; disk reads resolve under root, bound size and compare normalized bytes. Research verification explicitly refuses when no semantic verifier exists. Legacy IntakeResearchSourcesUseCase builds then discards artifacts, returns no receipts and hashes only ordered content digests.
file_reviews.limitations: Custody does not prove research claims or Git-tracked state; bundle_name is unused in legacy helper. File resolve/stat/read lacks adversarial concurrent-filesystem isolation; no scripts executed.

file_reviews.assessment: Full prompt rewrite read. Renders supplied text/segments or span descriptions and hashes resulting UTF-8 output; boundary parser used only for RewriteRequest segments.
file_reviews.limitations: Wrapping unescaped text in task tags is presentation, not a tool or instruction isolation barrier. Partition form contains span metadata, not source text or semantic equivalence evidence.

file_reviews.assessment: Full demo runner read. Catalog miss refuses; runner exceptions become infrastructure failure. Pilot branch requires typed receipt and transitions trial from all_passed.
file_reviews.limitations: No caller-level receipt demo/seed binding check; by-ID and all variants return injected output unchanged. Receipt evidence is execution-test context, not pilot answer acceptance or provider effectiveness.

file_reviews.assessment: Full scoring owner read. Legacy EvaluateCoboundaryScoreUseCase counts claimed IDs against a bare total and marks exact when count saturates plus reference presence; neither open-ID membership nor witness checked. Float diagnostics accept some nonfinite inputs and measure declared masses. Canonical score_discrete/cochain and rank operations delegate to Rust port with exact rational normalization and explicit policy; these are different paths.
file_reviews.limitations: Cardinality score is not Phi1, physical fidelity, or semantic truth. Cost/obstruction declarations and detector vocabulary remain admitted; finite arithmetic and ranking cannot establish source adequacy.

file_reviews.assessment: Full symbol-game runner including guarded historical body read. Functional guard precedes fixed scripted open-path/closed-cycle demo; fixture opt-in and explicit emitter required downstream. Body sets strict_descent_passed=True even unchanged intermediate regimes and manufactures terminal candidate on last step, so it cannot represent general task solving.
file_reviews.limitations: Guarded/unreachable legacy demonstration is not a current successful run. Mathematical boundary closure for fixed graph does not validate arbitrary input/refactoring, debate or source semantics.

file_reviews.assessment: Full symbol-turn service read. Compiles text packet, computes supplied SBE observable, hashes text/task/purity; explicitly holds with is_exact=False.
file_reviews.limitations: Floating text purity is not exactness, resolution or physical-state evidence. Result correctly avoids certification.

file_reviews.assessment: Full symbolic-dialogue entrypoint read. All scenario methods call functional-unavailable guard before run-directory creation; base_output_dir retained only as inert configuration.
file_reviews.limitations: Named scenarios do not constitute executed solvers or evidence.

file_reviews.assessment: Full contract-verification API read. Catalog/contract reads never manufacture success: all available declarations return HOST_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE and pilot evidence/state is not replaced. Missing data and errors return explicit refusals. This is a useful guard against declaration-as-proof but not an implemented compliance/confluence checker.
file_reviews.limitations: Injected storage behavior not re-audited; no verification receipt or pilot success is established.

file_reviews.assessment: Full glyph-reply caller read. Unknown/duplicate fields (when raw pairs supplied), carrier pinning, host presentation registry, per-row refusals and rederivation prevent dropping unchecked rows. Missing host pins downgrade authority; terminal also checks emission carrier.
file_reviews.limitations: Docstring one-form decider claim needs dedicated current row_rederivation review. Packet schema literal is not validated, malformed/missing rows normalize to empty, duplicate detection is optional after dict parsing. Supplied reply_text is not proved to encode supplied rows; semantic completeness of omitted claims is outside this checker.
